rules.statement: The bridge must serialize reads and must never issue speculative reads.

rules.condition: Eligible bufferable Normal Write-back AHB write bursts
rules.statement: The bridge may aggregate eligible bufferable Normal Write-back AHB write bursts into AXI4 bursts of up to 16 beats.
The bridge must never merge Device writes.
Reads must always use AXI single-beat transactions.
The bridge must provide Full AHB5 Subordinate to AXI4 Manager conversion (FEAT-001).
The bridge must use one shared synchronous clock and reset (FEAT-002).
The bridge must implement strict no-speculation serialized reads (FEAT-003).

rules.condition: Bufferable Normal Write-back; full fixed burst; uniform AXI address attributes
rules.statement: The bridge must support conditional aggregation of bufferable Normal Write-back fixed writes up to 16 beats (FEAT-004).
Rotating AXI read/write IDs are an optional configuration with ID-count parameters 1..8, default 1.
The bridge must convert AHB HWSTRB to AXI WSTRB (FEAT-007).
Parity, exclusive and CSR functions are not included and must be disabled in this revision.
